name: District Electoral Areas 1984

references.label: District Electoral Areas Commissioner (Sir Frank Harrison): final recommendations, 1984
references.note: Established 98 district electoral areas (December 1984) under the District Electoral Areas Commissioner (Northern Ireland) Order 1984, as recited in the 1992 Commissioner's report. Printed report and maps; no online copy found.

references.label: District Electoral Areas (Northern Ireland) Order 1985 (S.I. 1985 No. 169)
references.note: Gave effect to the 1984 recommendations for the May 1985 local elections.

references.label: District Electoral Areas Commissioner (Northern Ireland) Order 1984 (S.I. 1984 No. 360)
references.note: Made 14 Mar 1984, in operation 28 Mar 1984, under section 38(1)(a) of the Northern Ireland Constitution Act 1973. Provided for a District Electoral Areas Commissioner to recommend the grouping of each district's wards into electoral areas once the Local Government (Boundaries) Order had been made; the 1984 Commissioner's recommendations were given effect by the District Electoral Areas (Northern Ireland) Order 1985.
